item.title: Yuri Hulchuk, The 23-year-old Ukrainian Marine was captured defending Mariupol on April 12, 2022. In captivity, he was brutally tortured.
item.description: When he finally returned home in September 2024, Yuri could barely speak. He struggled to eat and appeared unable to recognize his own mother. She had spent more than two years desperately searching for him. His speech gradually returned. He began communicating again and underwent rehabilitation, rebuilding a life that Russian captivity had tried to destroy. Now, Yuri is communicating normally; he stated that he wants to study again and focus on learning foreign languages. Yuri Hulchuk is a reminder that captivity can break a body and scar a mind, but it cannot erase the human will to survive and continue to go forward!

item.title: The Last Human - Skeleton [OC]
item.description: Fun fact! As Humans age, part of their skeleton really does fall out! No one knows why this is. Some have speculated that this is in the first step of some sort of molting process, or it may have to do with the development of highly acidic (or even flammable?) saliva. As no Network Emissary ever survived contact with this species, records are understandably sketchy. - I know, I know, Imgur has changed. I watched it happen. Some of you have no idea we used to post comics here all the time, but I hope you enjoy this one. For those who remember us, I've created a handy FAQ below: Q: Where the hell have you been?? A: Making things is hard, and mental health is fierce and fickle mistress. Q: Is that a quote from Sealab 2021? A: Yes it is. Q: Are you still making comics?? A: Absolutely. We've put 200+ pages of *new* comics on acrowdedgalaxy.com (and N. K. Jemisin said she liked it!). We're also adding writer/artist commentary, if that's your thing. I've also been working on a cinematic mode, so let me know what you think of that. Q: Wait. So I have to pay for something? A: Not unless you're *really* passionate about supporting us. Just DM me and I'll give it to you. Q: Does Imgur still insert random line breaks in image descriptions? A: Apparently? Q: What's your opinion on the Great Filter? A: It has to be some sort of amusement apocalypse, right? Like every species finally figures out how to separate pleasure from food and reproduction with Neuralinks or something and then we all die because we forget to eat. OR one guy finally gets all wealth on earth like that one Cixin Liu story. I could be wrong. --- https://ACrowdedGalaxy.com

item.title: GovBrief Today #558
item.description: ICE agents chased down an American mother in Virginia and put a gun in her face because she cursed at them. Carolina Molina was dropping off business cards at immigration law offices in Falls Church when she told the agents arresting two men what she thought of them. Two SUVs boxed in her car and forced her to stop, and the first agent to reach her window arrived with his gun already drawn. He accused her of following them and of trying to run them over. Her dashcam disproved both, and when she told him that she was a legal citizen, he answered, "I don't care." The same day, the AP revealed ICE's plans to spend up to $20 million on thousands of electric shock gloves for its agents through a no-bid contract. The manufacturer warns they should never be used on someone for verbal defiance, which is all Carolina Molina did before a gun was pointed at her.
